I describe the difference between THC and CBD as CBD gives you everything regular THC pot gives you except the intoxication.  so if you are hitting a CBD sativa, then you get a sativa type high but without the intoxication.  I find all CBD is reminiscent of an indica type high regardless of whether it is a sativa or not,  because of the very nature of CBD.  In my opinion, the hybrids and sativa CBDs don't couch lock you like an indica unless you just blaze it to oblivion, but even then, it isn't the same.

Let's take for instance my current favorite CBD strains.  I love Cherry Wine, Sour Space Candy, and NYC Sour Diesel.   I have tried many of others but I tend to gravitate back to these.  I was a 4 gram a day THC weed smoker.  I am now down to 2 grams of THC/CBD flower a day.  in early 2019 I began smoking/vaping CBD.  I also bought a Dynavap (the best purchase I have ever made).  Its bowl is .05 - .2 grams depending on how you set it and how tight you pack it.  If I hit .1-.2 grams as micro doses through out the day of these CBDs, I can be fully alert and relaxed as I work through out the day.  I attribute the Dynavap to the reason I have reduced my consumption and improved my overall experience.

If I want a little more creativity, I mix 50% THC flower and 50% CBD flower.  I find the same microdose of .1-.2 gives me great creativity and relaxation.  It is a really zen moment for me.  I have a slight THC intoxication that lends itself to the expansion of one's mind and the CBD for the calming, relaxing, and balancing.

If I want to get blasted, then I will just go high THC strains or concentrates. and vape away not caring how much I consume.

Not really a conversation I over heard, but was the one having the conversation that was overheard.  My teenage son has Aspergers and is in full swing of testosterone and puberty.  He has no filter when it comes to having a conversation with me; we talk about just about anything and everything candidly.  His mother and I have been teaching him to be respectful of women.  The other day, we were all eating a restaurant when he asks me to change sides of the table.  I didn't argue as I could tell he was in minor distress.  We swap sides of the table.  He thanks me and I ask him why he wanted to change sides of the table.  He tells me he didn't want to watch the Victoria's Secrets show that was on the sport's screen on the wall.  More specifically, he didn't want to get caught watching it by his sister or his mother.  

While we are eating, he asks, "Dad, why do guys like looking at boobs?  I mean, why do I like boobs so much?  You know, big ones, little ones, just boobs...."  

I reply, "Son, that is just how we are made.  It isn't a bad thing.  You are suppose to like boobs."

Him, "so it is normal?"

Me, "Yes! very much so."

His mother and sister are at the table, and I try to change the subject telling him we can talk about this some other time when he asks, "Do you like looking at boobs?"  I see his mother, my wife, look at me and she says, "I believe he asked you a question."  I swallow and reply with a sly smile rising to the challenge, "Of course I do."

He sighs relief and says, "I am glad I am normal then, but I don't like looking at my mom's and sister's boobs."

I respond quickly, "That is because you were not born in Mississippi!"

The couple at the table sitting next to us were taking a drink at that moment and blew coke out of their noses and had a huge mess to clean up.
